allocation_policy: Admission only copies <=65536 bytes plus fixed native metadata (two blocks/five packets), prefix spans and no per-token objects. A successful edit builds <=65536 bytes then calls existing Parse/CheckMutation; no template or duplicate codec. Gap index <=65540 bytes in mutation-admitted revisions. Parse retains prior16MiB/1M policies unchanged.
traversal_policy: Fixed prefix field table,8 prefix extents sorted; linear <=16384 body token visits per admission. Typeover scans at most input text length and never crosses a code. Input text length checked before constructing output.

fuzz.seeds: actual ORIGIN and actual two-pair repair-Restore; labelled synthetic malformed/unmatched/opaque/above-pair-limit/max-token inputs

measurements: Record go test benchmarks B/op/allocs and /usr/bin/time max RSS for harness separately; neither is a product SLO nor per-document peak-live bound. No repeated budget expansion after passing.
